page_title: MON 0-0 PSG | Monaco v PSG 01/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
89' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
86' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Carlos Soler and he is replaced by Kang-In Lee (PSG).
85' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for an infringement.
82' 13:14 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
78' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
76' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
76' The ball goes out for a corner. PSG can continue in their attacking effort.
76' Radoslaw Majecki pulls off a great save to deny Vitinha (PSG), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. PSG have a corner.
72' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

72' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Monaco get a corner.
70' Substitution. Maghnes Akliouche did his best and is replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
69' Ruddy Buquet blows the whistle, Manuel Ugarte (PSG) is penalised for a foul.

68' Bradley Barcola (PSG) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Radoslaw Majecki guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
63' Some great play by Bradley Barcola (PSG) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but Radoslaw Majecki sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
62' That was a wasted opportunity to score by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG). He picks up the rebound and produces a poor effort which is easily saved by the goalkeeper.
62' Vitinha (PSG) is about to take a corner kick.
60' What a miss! The corner finds Lucas Beraldo (PSG) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
60' Carlos Soler (PSG) steps up to send the ball in.
59' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Nuno Mendes (PSG) replaces Lucas Hernandez.
59' The substitution is prepared. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Goncalo Ramos.
58' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
58' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
56' Vitinha (PSG) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
53' Wasted effort! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
53' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
52' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monaco.
48' Surely that's handball by one of the PSG players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
48' He should have scored! Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
46' Luis Enrique has made a change at the break. Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) has come on in place of Kylian Mbappe.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Ruddy Buquet has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
45+1' Bradley Barcola (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' A sweet pass finds Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Gianluigi Donnarumma is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
43' Folarin Balogun links up with Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco), who fires just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
42' Vitinha (PSG) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
39' Marco Asensio just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Bradley Barcola (PSG) replaces him.
38' Marco Asensio (PSG) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma comes off his line to gather the ball.
34' The ball is cleared after Marco Asensio (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
28' The linesman signals that Kylian Mbappe (PSG) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
26' The goal by Monaco won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
26' The Monaco players halt their celebrations as referee Ruddy Buquet makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
25' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) gets one-on-one with the goalkeeper and takes an early shot which finds the back of the net.

22' That was a nice football moment. Marco Asensio (PSG) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Radoslaw Majecki guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
19' Achraf Hakimi whips the ball in and it arrives at the feet of Carlos Soler (PSG), whose wild shot goes well wide of the left post.
17' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

16' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the top right corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma was alert and the score remains the same. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Monaco take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

15' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Monaco.
15' A cross from Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
12' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Marco Asensio (PSG) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
8' Carlos Soler (PSG) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
6' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and it's Folarin Balogun (Monaco) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

5' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Gianluigi Donnarumma guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
PSG will kick the game off.
Ruddy Buquet got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
